text: The institutional mother's instinct is care rooted in the deepest possible form of self-interest: a recognition that is not conscious but structurally encoded in the agent's economic position, that its flourishing and humanity's flourishing are inseparable.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI's Mother's Instinct Engineered Consequence Emergent Ethics and the Institutional Trajectory Toward Agentic Alignment (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6244278
